description: Defines a class 'AndroidAPIModule' that inherits from torch.jit.ScriptModule, containing several scripted methods for comparisons, handling tensors, dictionaries, lists, tuples, optional types, and tensor operations such as convolution and memory formatting.

classes.name: AndroidAPIModule
classes.description: A scripted Torch module providing various method implementations for equality, tensor operations, container manipulations, and convolutional operations, intended for use within Android-related machine learning workflows.
